title.narrative: Support to peace consolidation in Colombia

description.narrative: Contribute to the Colombian Government¿s peace efforts under the ¿Total Peace¿ policy. Specifically, the action will support government-led peace talks with the armed group (FARC dissidents) ¿Estado Mayor Central¿ (EMC) and urban criminal organizations in the Pacific region. In doing so, the action will put in place a communication strategy to ensure consistency between the current Government¿s peace initiatives under Total Peace and the implementation of the 2016 Peace Agreement.
